mcqs.question: The October 2025 discussion titled “UN at 80 — reviving multilateralism” was held in the context of which milestone?
options: The 80th anniversary of the United Nations
The 80th session of the UN General Assembly
mcqs.explanation: The discussion marked the 80th anniversary of the United Nations. The 80th UNGA was also associated with the UN-at-80 context, but it is a separate milestone and is not the anniversary itself.
